usedFor: Stripe takes the payment and QuickBooks keeps the books. “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe can run “Create Payment” in QuickBooks, so cash received is recorded without someone typing it in.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Create Payment” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: A successful payment is money in, and “Create Payment” records the transaction, which keeps your books matching your Stripe balance.

watchOut: “Invoice Is Finalized” and “When a checkout session is completed” also run “Create Payment”. One sale can fire more than one, so pick one trigger or it is recorded twice.
